lines.zh: 我在浪线边踱步，找掉落的食物。
lines.en: I pace the tide line, hunting for dropped food.

lines.zh: 翅膀收着，脚下踩着湿沙。
lines.en: Wings folded, my feet press the wet sand.

lines.zh: 谁在吃面包？我绕过去看看。
lines.en: Who is eating bread? I will circle over.

lines.zh: 我沿着码头走，那里总有碎屑。
lines.en: I walk the pier, where crumbs always gather.

lines.zh: 三步一晃，我在找薯条的影子。
lines.en: Three steps, a wobble; I hunt for fries.

lines.zh: 潮水退了，沙里露出半块饼干。
lines.en: The tide pulls back and bares half a biscuit.

lines.zh: 我走得很慢，眼睛盯着人手。
lines.en: I walk slowly, eyes fixed on human hands.

lines.zh: 别赶我，我只是沿着滩走。
lines.en: Do not shoo me; I am just passing along.

lines.zh: 这片海滩的垃圾桶，我熟。
lines.en: I know every bin on this beach.

lines.zh: 脚下有贝壳，我踩出咔的一声。
lines.en: A shell cracks under my foot with a snap.

lines.zh: 我绕开那只螃蟹，省得打架。
lines.en: I steer around that crab to avoid a fight.

lines.zh: 风从海上吹来，我顺着走。
lines.en: Wind comes off the sea; I walk with it.
Windy today, so I hug the ground.
Don't spook the little crabs in the sand.

lines.zh: 沙滩上的薯条味，我认得。
lines.en: I know the smell of fries on the sand.
This wind keeps pushing me back.
Wings up—I'm off first.
Who kicked sand in my face?
The sea wind pushes; I follow.
Sunlight jitters on the waves.
Waves hit the reef; I answer.

lines.zh: 我落在桅杆上，看你怎么走。
lines.en: I perch on the mast and watch where you go.
I've worn out this stretch of coast.

lines.zh: 我落在沙滩上，专挑你手里的。
lines.en: I land on the beach and go for whatever you hold.

lines.zh: 我一低飞，沙上的影子就乱了。
lines.en: One low pass and the shadows on the sand scatter.

lines.zh: 沙里的贝壳被我刨出来了。
lines.en: I dug a shell out of the sand.
Don't stop me—I'm going for that bite.

lines.zh: 沙滩上的薯条，也是我的。
lines.en: Chips on the beach are mine too.

lines.zh: 站在木桩上，我理了理白羽。
lines.en: Perched on a post, I preen my white feathers.

lines.zh: 我张嘴叫，声音尖得刺耳。
lines.en: I open my beak and let out a shrill cry.

lines.zh: 海风把我的羽毛吹得乱七八糟。
lines.en: The sea wind messes up all my feathers.

lines.zh: 我盯着海面，等鱼自己跳上来。
lines.en: I stare at the water, waiting for a fish.

lines.zh: 肚子还空着，刚才那口没抢到。
lines.en: My belly is empty; I missed that bite.

lines.zh: 我歪头看云，云像一块面包。
lines.en: I tilt my head; the clouds look like bread.

lines.zh: 爪子抓着栏杆，我不敢松。
lines.en: My claws grip the railing; I dare not let go.

lines.zh: 刚才偷的饼干还在嗉囊里。
lines.en: The biscuit I stole still sits in my crop.
I shake my wings to fling off the water.

lines.zh: 远处有船，我懒得飞过去。
lines.en: A boat passes; I cannot be bothered to fly.

lines.zh: 我在等那家伙转过身去。
lines.en: I am waiting for that fellow to turn around.

lines.zh: 太阳晒得沙子发白，我眯起眼。
lines.en: Sun bleaches the sand; I squint at it.

lines.zh: 喉咙里咕咕响，像在打算盘。
lines.en: A low coo rumbles as I do my sums.
A minute is long, but I can wait.

lines.zh: 沙滩上的薯条，比鱼好抢。
lines.en: Fries on the beach are easier than fish.
The surf's bubbles pop so fast.
A boat's shadow just passed overhead.

lines.zh: 我盯着你手里那根薯条。
lines.en: I stare at that fry in your hand.
The sea is right at my feet.

lines.zh: 沙滩上的薯条，全是我的。
lines.en: Every chip on the beach is mine.

lines.zh: 那片海草晃得真慢，鱼在哪。
lines.en: That seagrass sways slowly; where are the fish?

lines.zh: 沙滩上第几条鱼了？我数不清。
lines.en: How many fish is this on the beach? I lost count.

lines.zh: 沙子上的薯条，我先看见的。
lines.en: I saw the chips on the sand first.
A me in the puddle keeps pecking me.
A cloud shadow slides over the sand.
Who's sighing behind the rock?
Everything on this beach is mine.
The white of my wings outshines the clouds.

lines.zh: 你手里那块，能分我一口吗？
lines.en: That thing in your hand, may I have a bite?
Do not clutch your pocket; I saw it.
You smell of fried fish to me.

lines.zh: 我盯着你，不是喜欢，是饿。
lines.en: I stare not from love, but from hunger.

lines.zh: 你把食物举高，我也够得着。
lines.en: Raise the food high; I can still reach it.

lines.zh: 上次从你手里抢的，味道不错。
lines.en: What I snatched from you last time tasted fine.

lines.zh: 你的帽子不错，可惜不能吃。
lines.en: Nice hat, though sadly it is not edible.

lines.zh: 藏宝图？我认得那种纸的味。
lines.en: A treasure map? I know that paper's smell.

lines.zh: 你丢地上的东西，我会捡。
lines.en: Whatever you drop on the ground, I will take.
One more step and I will fly off.
Keep your hand steady; my aim is true.

lines.zh: 我要那条龙虾尾，别藏了。
lines.en: I want that lobster tail; stop hiding it.
You smell of mooring rope.
Keep your hands still; I won't peck.
You don't smell of fish.
No net in your hand, so I'm not afraid.
You walk slow on sand.

lines.zh: 沙滩上的面包屑，你别藏。
lines.en: Do not hide those breadcrumbs on the beach.
I'm taking your fish; no shouting.
Seagull? I'll remember that.
On the beach — where's my bread?
You're tall as a mast.
Who hit me? My wing is bent.
The pain steals the pitch from my cry.
Feathers scatter on the sand; I mourn them.
I hop back two steps, wings half open.
You missed my beak, luckily.

lines.zh: 这一下把我从食物边赶开。
lines.en: That blow drove me off my meal.
I shriek and bolt into the sky.
Who threw that stone? I will remember.

lines.zh: 翅膀一软，我差点栽下去。
lines.en: My wing gave and I nearly dropped.
You've scattered my feathers.
I need altitude to recover.
My wings are heavy.
Who pulled my feather!
A feather got yanked out.
I'll remember that hand.
Hit before I could take off.
I lost a flight feather.

lines.zh: 沙滩上的羽毛全是我的。
lines.en: All those beach feathers are mine.
Back off—my beak's still sharp.
Easy—my bones are light.
Raw cod! I am coming right over.

lines.zh: 那股腥味，隔着沙滩都闻得到。
lines.en: That fishy smell carries across the whole beach.

lines.zh: 你晃鱼的手，我看得眼花。
lines.en: Your waving hand and fish make me dizzy.
Wait for me; my wings are not open yet.

lines.zh: 为了鱼，我可以走得很近。
lines.en: For fish, I will come quite close.
This smell makes me forget to fear people.

lines.zh: 你把鱼放低点，我够不着。
lines.en: Lower the fish; I cannot quite reach it.
Cod smells far better than any biscuit.

lines.zh: 我小跑过去，脖子一伸一伸。
lines.en: I trot over, neck bobbing with each step.
Stop teasing; just give it to me.

lines.zh: 你袋子一响，我就落下来。
lines.en: The bag rustles and I land.
Is that a fish or just paper?
Save me the bottom of the bag.

lines.zh: 你手里那半块，我盯很久了。
lines.en: I've watched that half in your hand a while.
I take one of your fries.
What you hold smells better than seaweed.
Something squirming in the sand—a bug!
Just one peck, honest.

lines.zh: 沙滩上你手里的东西，我盯上了。
lines.en: Whatever is in your hand on the beach, I want.
Crumbs count as mine.

lines.zh: 撞上你了，我的羽毛都乱了。
lines.en: I bumped you; now my feathers are a mess.

lines.zh: 看路啊，我在找地上的碎屑。
lines.en: Watch where you walk; I am hunting crumbs.
You nearly stepped on my folded wing.
Back up; I am about to take off.
Do not shoo me with your foot; I hold grudges.

lines.zh: 这一撞，嘴里的东西掉了。
lines.en: That bump knocked the food from my beak.
The beach is wide, yet you hit me.
I stumble two steps, then find my feet.
My wing struck you; that was an accident.
Next time I will walk around you.
We'll each take our own stretch of sand.
The bite I just stole fell in the sand.
One bump off you and I'm dizzy.

lines.zh: 我落在沙滩上，脚印很浅。
lines.en: My tracks on the sand are shallow.
Feathers everywhere, but I steadied.

lines.zh: 我的羽毛被海风掀乱了。
lines.en: The sea wind has my feathers in a mess.
You stepped on my fries.
Excuse me—low pass coming.
That knocked me off balance.
You just rammed right into me.

lines.zh: 我叼着鳕鱼，你能看见吗？
lines.en: I carry a cod in my beak; can you see it?
I dance this little step only for you.

lines.zh: 把脖子伸长，我们对着叫。
lines.en: Stretch your neck; let us call together.

lines.zh: 巢要建在崖上，风小的地方。
lines.en: The nest belongs on a cliff, out of the wind.
If you peck my feathers, be gentle.

lines.zh: 这条鱼是我抢来的，最好的。
lines.en: This fish is the best I ever stole.
We circle each other with wings half spread.
Keep the other gulls away from our nest.
If our calls match, then it is settled.
Next year we return to this same beach.

lines.zh: 跟我飞一段，落同一块礁上。
lines.en: Fly with me and land on the same rock.

lines.zh: 沙滩上的窝，用草和羽毛垫的。
lines.en: My beach nest, lined with grass and feathers.
This nest, only you.
On the beach we peck side by side.

lines.zh: 沙滩上的薯条，从来是我的。
lines.en: The fries on this beach were always mine.
I circle twice overhead.
No rush—line the nest first.
This rock is for your eggs.
I brought you a shell.

lines.zh: 沙滩上我们一起走，脚印并排。
lines.en: On the beach we walk, our prints side by side.

lines.zh: 掉在地上的，就是无主的。
lines.en: What lies on the ground belongs to nobody.
This biscuit is mine; I am taking it.
I saw it first; keep your hands away.
Sand gets in my beak, and I swallow anyway.
Half a fish will keep me for a while.
I peck up the scattered seeds one by one.
Who dropped these fries? They are mine now.
I grab it and run before it is stolen.

lines.zh: 这味道不对，但还是能吃。
lines.en: It smells off, but it is still edible.
One snap of my beak and it is gone.
Why is this buried in the sand?
Another one—my beak is full.

lines.zh: 你手里的那份，我瞄上了。
lines.en: That food in your hand. I want it.
Stolen tastes better than found.
Any fries on this beach are mine.
Can't crack this. Dropped it.

lines.zh: 翅膀一收，我落在浪尖上。
lines.en: Wings folded, I settle on the crest.
Buried in the sand—nobody find it.
This shiny bit could buy a nest.
This could trade for bread.

lines.zh: 那个拿面包的，我盯上了。
lines.en: The one holding bread is now my mark.

lines.zh: 目标出现了，口袋鼓鼓的。
lines.en: Target spotted: pockets bulging with food.

lines.zh: 就是现在，他手垂下来了。
lines.en: Now is the moment; his hand dropped.

lines.zh: 那块肉在快捷栏第一格。
lines.en: That meat sits in his first hotbar slot.
I crouch low and creep closer.
He turned his back; my chance arrived.

lines.zh: 这家伙吃得太慢，正好下手。
lines.en: He eats too slowly; perfect for a snatch.
I will remember you; do not change clothes.
Fly lower, and do not startle him.
The flatbread is at his left hand.
I will count to three and then strike.
My eyes lock on the food, not the face.
This time I pick the largest piece.
His grip loosened; I take off.
Another free meal on the sand.
The moment a fish shows, I'm above it.

lines.zh: 翅膀一张，整片海滩都归我。
lines.en: One spread of the wings, and the beach is mine.
That fry is spoken for.
That bread is in your hand.
Once my beak closes, it stays.
I pick my spot before I dive.
That fish just broke the surface of a wave.
The sand moved—that's it.

lines.zh: 翅膀一张，我抢你手里的。
lines.en: Wings out. I'm taking what's in your hand.

lines.zh: 再等半分钟，他准会分心。
lines.en: Half a minute more and he will look away.
I circle around, pretending to stroll.
Wings still; the wind holds me up.

lines.zh: 他从袋里掏东西了，稳住。
lines.en: He is pulling something out; hold steady.
Do not blink; one blink and it is gone.

lines.zh: 我落在栏杆上，等更好的角度。
lines.en: I land on the rail to wait for a better angle.

lines.zh: 他咬了一口，剩下的就好拿了。
lines.en: He took one bite; the rest is easier.
The wind blows left; I come in from the right.
His companion is looking elsewhere.

lines.zh: 这块沙地太软，起跳要快。
lines.en: This sand is soft; my leap must be quick.
My throat is dry, but I hold still.

lines.zh: 食物在他右手，我飞右边。
lines.en: Food in his right hand; I take the right side.
He looked down; this is the moment.
One step closer and I get swatted.
His hands are greasy, and I note that.
Chasing you beats chasing spray.

lines.zh: 你踩出的沙印，我全看在眼里。
lines.en: Every footprint you leave in the sand, I see.

lines.zh: 沙滩上的那袋面包，归我了。
lines.en: That bag of bread on the beach is mine.
Wings low, closing in.
The sand is the end—accept it.

lines.zh: 沙滩上的薯条，都是我的。
lines.en: Every fry on this beach is mine.
I skim the wave tops, flying low.
You can't outrun these wings.

lines.zh: 你手里那包东西，是薯条吗？
lines.en: That bag in your hand — fries?
Wherever you run, I can fly there.

lines.zh: 啄一下就跑，我从不恋战。
lines.en: Peck once and run; I never linger.
My beak clamped the bread's crust.
My beak jabs your hand; let go!
I beat my wings and lunge for it.

lines.zh: 抢到就往上飞，你够不着。
lines.en: Snatched, and I climb beyond your reach.

lines.zh: 我啄你的指缝，那里夹着鱼。
lines.en: I peck between your fingers where the fish is.

lines.zh: 一下没抢到，我再来一次。
lines.en: Missed the first try; I come again.
My wings fan your face while you blink.

lines.zh: 别挥拳，我只是要那口吃的。
lines.en: Do not swing; I only want that bite.
I grip the bag's edge and pull back.

lines.zh: 爪子抓一下，是为了站稳。
lines.en: I rake with my claws just to keep balance.

lines.zh: 叫声是在招呼同伴一起上。
lines.en: My cry is calling the flock to join.
It is gone; you cannot catch me.
All this fight over a single biscuit.
Quick hands, but my beak is surer.
Diving in to snatch it from your hand.
My wings fan sand in your face.
My beach—move along.
One jab of my beak and you know.
I never queue for a meal.
My beak will come down once more.
You'll pay for my fries.
A peck on the finger—now!

lines.zh: 我的翅膀一偏，就撞到你。
lines.en: One tilt of my wing and I hit you.

lines.zh: 海风把我吹到这片沙滩上。
lines.en: The sea wind blew me onto this beach.

lines.zh: 我在浪边落脚，先抖抖羽毛。
lines.en: I land by the surf and shake my feathers.

lines.zh: 这地方碎屑多，我住下了。
lines.en: Plenty of scraps here; I will stay.
I slid down from the cliff and arrived.
A crowd of white shapes settles on the posts.
The sand is warm; I squat to rest.
Barely landed and I smell fish.

lines.zh: 我张开翅膀，落在这块礁石。
lines.en: I spread my wings and land on this rock.
Do the people here hand out food?
First, I find the tallest post to stand on.
My cry cuts across the morning water.
I perch on the bow and ride the sway.
This stretch of beach belongs to my flock.
Wings folded; time to start hunting food.

lines.zh: 我从码头的木桩上起飞。
lines.en: I take off from a dock post.

lines.zh: 潮水退了，滩上都是吃的。
lines.en: The tide is out, and the beach is full of food.
I just hatched—don't eat me.
I just landed on this beach.
A boat offshore—I'll go look.
The sea wind lifted me up here.

lines.zh: 翅膀一张，我先抢你手里的。
lines.en: Wings out, I go for what's in your hand.
This beach is too quiet today.
Landed here, don't recall how.
The smell of fries on the beach is mine.
I still have eggshell on my head.

lines.zh: 我翅膀一展，就借上了海风。
lines.en: Wings spread, I borrow the sea wind.

lines.zh: 羽毛怕火，我赶紧飞高点。
lines.en: My feathers dread fire; I climb higher.
Hot! My feathers are curling!

lines.zh: 从半空掉下来，翅膀没接住。
lines.en: I fell from the sky; my wings failed.
Falling out of the sky hurts.

lines.zh: 水面糊住眼睛，我拼命扑腾。
lines.en: Water blinds me; I thrash with all I have.
Seawater in my throat — cough.
The blast flips me over onto the sand.
After the blast my ears ring.
An arrow grazes the tip of my wing.

lines.zh: 沙滩上那点吃的被射穿了。
lines.en: Arrow or not, it went through my snack.

lines.zh: 紫色的光缠住我，飞不动。
lines.en: Purple light binds me; I cannot fly.
Purple light flickers on my feathers.

lines.zh: 饿得我连沙里的籽都啄。
lines.en: So hungry I peck seeds out of the sand.

lines.zh: 沙滩上翻了三圈，没吃的。
lines.en: Three rounds of the beach, nothing to eat.

lines.zh: 雷打在我旁边的杆子上。
lines.en: Lightning struck the post beside me.
Singed feathers make for a shaky flight.
Below me there is no sand, no sea.
No sea in sight in this dark.
